يعتدوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَدُوا (yaʕtadū) /jaʕ.ta.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# يُعْتَدَوْا (yuʕtadaw) /juʕ.ta.daw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
